803-5414-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5414-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2092-4687-5268.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2092-4687-5268.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
2092-4687-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

985-4067-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

4365-4772-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
4365-4772-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

372-1621-3306.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1621-3306.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

3617-7638-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mind Stone.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-7297.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1734-4605-5686-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2034-7195.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

296-3532-3836-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-4677-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

11-2104-2928-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2104-2928-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Manipulation from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1987-2128-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1987-2128-5913.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Pinnacle Monk and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1668-4128-4659-5963.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1668-4128-4659-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Chainer's ability by discarding a card, allowing you to cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marvin, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Marvin from your graveyard by paying {2}.
When Marvin enters the battlefield, Chainer triggers, giving Marvin haste until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Loran's ability by tapping it, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Repeat.

4452-4929-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
4452-4929-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Cryptic Trilobite for additional mana.

1315-2653-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
1315-2653-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger that many times.
Resolve all Nissa triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1818-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1818-3490-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Healer of the Pride indestructible.
1818-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

803-2585-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
803-2585-3767-3918.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
803-2585-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

372-2187-5530.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Possessed Skaab exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
372-2187-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2292-3605-5145.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2947-4050-4089.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding one mana of any color.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat.

549-1565-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mintstrosity, adding {C}{C}.
When Mintstrosity dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Mintstrosity trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Mintstrosity from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1580-1599-2178-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Yawgmoth.
Priest of Yawgmoth does not have summoning sickness.
1580-1599-2178-3263.description:
Activate Priest of Yawgmoth by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Priest of Yawgmoth triggers, untapping Priest of Yawgmoth.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2054-3525-3784.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
2054-3525-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

628-1365-4050-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Dross Scorpion persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding one mana of any color.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability, its undying ability and its persist ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding one mana of any color.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding one mana of any color.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its persist ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1902-2024.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
1902-2024.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Wirewood Channeler and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
If there are at least five Elves on the battlefield, this combo nets infinite colored mana.
